content:
`tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` now rounds half-up. I didn't run it or any tests.

It was an unimplemented stub (`raise NotImplementedError`), so there was no existing rounding to change. I wrote it to multiply `amount_cents` by `rate` as a `Decimal` and round to a whole cent with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. It returns an `int`. For example, 5 cents at a 10% rate gives 0.5, which rounds up to 1 (half-even would give 0).

I also updated the stored project memory, which said tax uses `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` and not to use half-up. It now records half-up and notes that finance reversed the March 2026 decision.

I assumed `rate` is a fraction like `0.0825`, since nothing in the repo showed how it's passed. If it's a percentage, the formula needs a `/ 100`.
